_schema: Curated concept FAMILIES = the organs of the Qur'ānic universe. The measured Louvain themes are weak/soft (modularity ≈ 0.03, one blended field), so families here are CURATED thematic groupings seeded by the measure — not crisp auto-clusters. Each: name, organ_role (its function in the whole — how the elephant uses it), members[] (rasm roots), colour. Grows as concepts are profiled.

inner_self.name: The inner self / heart
inner_self.organ_role: the RECEIVER — the faculty that responds (or fails to) to guidance; where the text's address lands

mercy_relief.name: Mercy & relief
mercy_relief.organ_role: the ambient FIELD — the default divine stance the whole system runs within

command_law.name: Command & law
command_law.organ_role: the STRUCTURE — the imperative/legislative spine (do/forbid, judge, ordain)

cosmos.name: Cosmos / creation
cosmos.organ_role: the STAGE — the created universe the drama plays out on (heaven·earth merism)

eschatology.name: Eschatology / the horizon
eschatology.organ_role: the HORIZON — the end toward which everything is oriented (the Day, garden, fire)
